title: Playable indicator with a metric selector
description: Fictional global indicator values demonstrating RichView's playback and metric-swap controls. Values are invented for this authoring example.
version: 0.0.1
slug: playable-line-indicator

---

## Reading the chart

Press play to animate the time window. The axis label and units switch together when you change the metric, so values never drift from the measurement they describe.

```chart
type: line
title: Global demonstration indicator
subtitle: Invented quarterly values for the controls example
data:
  csv: data/indicator.csv
encoding:
  x: quarter
  y: value_abs
  color: region
axes:
  y:
    label: Indicator
    unit: units
controls:
  - kind: playback
    id: quarter
    field: quarter
    label: Quarter
    speed: 900
    loop: true
  - kind: metric
    id: measure
    label: Measure
    initial: absolute
    as: buttons
    options:
      - value: absolute
        label: Absolute
        field: value_abs
        axis:
          label: Indicator
          unit: units
      - value: per_capita
        label: Per capita
        field: value_per_cap
        axis:
          label: Indicator per capita
          unit: units/person
      - value: index
        label: Index (2020 Q1 = 100)
        field: value_index
        axis:
          label: Indicator, indexed
```

## How the controls read

The playback control holds the chart's time window at the selected quarter, so the mark identity for each region is preserved as the window slides forward. Changing the metric swaps the plotted column together with its axis label, unit and tooltip format — never one without the other.

Reduced motion is a hard floor: when the reader's system prefers reduced motion, the chart renders the last frame and the scrubber stays usable, but auto-play does not start and inter-frame animation is stepped rather than tweened.
